description: Measure time deposits maturing or repricing within a year, then test explicit renewal and replacement assumptions against tier-specific costs. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

certificate.description: FDIC certificate number of the bank.

renewalRatePercent.description: The rate you expect to pay on renewing time deposits. Leave empty to use the current Fed funds rate as a reference; the scenario table shows other reference rates.

retentionPercent.description: How much of the time deposits maturing within 12 months stay with the bank. The rest runs off and is replaced with other funding.

wholesaleSpreadBp.description: What you would pay above the Fed funds rate to replace deposits that run off, in basis points.
